scope: Short supplement to the immutable R1 semantic review. R3 was reviewed against immutable R1/R2/profile and the prior report; no production source, test source, catalog resource, real Vault, operator receipt, Git, network, or human-gate mutation was performed.

closure_review.assessment: R3 now requires exact producer identity sets, one owner/reference and assessment head per claim, exact original evidence count and ordinals 0..count-1, foreign-key resolution, exactly one coverage row per source/artifact, and ancestry-derived sorted sets. It also explicitly permits the intended unowned/unreferenced coverage states and null legacy display fields.

R3 fixes the order and domain: validate exact UTF-8 input, raw code-point/byte limits, NFKC then casefold, normalized code-point/byte limits, then token-count limit; overflow is SOURCE_CATALOG_LIMIT, blank/zero-token or invalid UTF-8 is SOURCE_CATALOG_INVALID, and no truncation.

R3 makes lifecycle a required active/retired reference value and assessment the validated ledger/event value, rejects missing/unknown/conflicting provenance without defaults, and requires source-excerpt hits to inherit the owning claim values including retired references.

R3 requires complete validated source/capture/parser/run or code-manifest ancestry before legacy resolution, treats ancestry failure as typed validation error rather than unsupported success, and forbids modern display selection from supplying legacy citation authority.

remaining_semantic_observation.text: The clarification also closes the cache-forgery path by requiring schema/canonical/self-digest parsing followed by complete current reconstruction and fresh producer assertions, including status. Required coverage and expansion tests are named. No unresolved semantic blocker remains in this rereview.

required_tests_reconfirmed: Projection set, ordinal, foreign-key, coverage-cardinality and malformed/missing history fixtures refuse before cache installation.
All five assessment values with active/retired lifecycle and source-excerpt inheritance.
Exact PDF/code ancestry success, ancestry mismatch typed error, and display selection independence.
Raw and normalized code-point/UTF-8 expansion at limits, token-count overflow, invalid UTF-8 and zero-token query error codes.
Forged/old cache versus complete current reconstruction, including status path.
decision_basis: R3 closes SEM-001 through SEM-004 with concrete producer, provenance, legacy ancestry, and query-bound rules. Existing R1/R2 IO/cache safety requirements and all prior review artifacts remain immutable and applicable.

implementation_boundary.allowed: This supplement only; no source/catalog/Git changes.
